section_summary.extract_value: This section details the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2), a 10-item measure used to assess body acceptance and respect. It describes the scale's development, its 5-point Likert response format, and its psychometric properties, including unidimensionality, invariance across sex and sample sources (undergraduate students and community adults), and high internal consistency reliability in both previous research and the present sample (α = .96).
